description: a 2 x 2 x 1 box against itself split another way: halves (two boxes fused across x = 1, whose faces keep the seam as an edge between coplanar pieces) and thirds (three boxes fused across y = 2/3 and y = 4/3). The same solid, so the overlap is the whole 4 and each operand lies in the other. Arris refused interference of the box against the halves with a tangent contact the faces do not have (the box's face is coincident with both coplanar pieces and imaged the seam twice), and the thirds against the halves with a kernel fault (a seam crossing another at the midpoint of one was read as one curve by `same_section`) - the training harness's phone_stand pairs, 100 of 100. The answers are Open CASCADE's
